card.title: PETLYAKOV Pe-2FT
card.flavorText: The Petlyakov Pe-2 “Peshka” (Russian: Pawn) was a Soviet Petlyakov dive bomber variant that was first introduced in 1941. It was an advanced aircraft for its time and came with a pressurized cabin and electrically actuated systems.The Pe-2FT was produced from 1942 to 1945 and was one of many Petlyakov variants, but the one that was produced in greatest numbers. It had an improved defensive armament, extra lower rear guns, dive brakes were removed and from early 1943 it was powered by PF or PF-2 engines. It had a 7.62 mm machine gun added in the dorsal turret to improve its defensive armament,  plus other upgrades.  A total of 11,427 Pe-2 aircraft were manufactured and this included variants such as the Pe-2FT bomber, the Pe-2R reconnaissance aircraft, the Pe-2UT trainer, the Pe-3bis fighter and other variants.
